lines.en: label iofirsthall:
scene iohall1
: Oh, Sensei. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei。怎么啦？

lines.en: : Not doing anything tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚没什么事做吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Just thought I’d say hi since you’re sitting here on the floor for some reason.
lines.zh: : 没有。只是看你好端端坐在地板上，就想过来打个招呼。

lines.en: : Just getting some fresh air. It’s kind of stuffy in the room at the moment.
lines.zh: : 透透气而已。屋里这会儿有点闷。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’d call the air in the dorm “fresh” but you do you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道宿舍里的空气算不算得上「新鲜」，不过随你高兴吧。

lines.en: : Well, what else am I supposed to do? Go outside? It’s freezing out there.
lines.zh: : 那我还能怎么办？出去吗？外面冷得要死。

lines.en: : Let me borrow your jacket and I’ll go outside. You can hang out here and watch movies in my bed or something.
lines.zh: : 那把外套借我，我出去。你留在这儿，躺我床上看电影什么的。

lines.en: : We’ll just swap places for a little bit. Does that work for you?
lines.zh: : 我们换个位置待一会儿。你看行吗？

lines.en: : I like my jacket and don’t particularly like movies, so no.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢我的外套，也不怎么喜欢看电影，所以不行。

lines.en: scene iohall2
: What kind of psychopath doesn’t like movies? What could possibly be the reasoning behind that?
lines.zh: : 什么样的人才会不喜欢看电影啊？这背后到底能有什么理由？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Staying in one place for too long is just boring.
lines.zh: : 不知道。在一个地方待太久就是很无聊。

lines.en: : Tell that to the weird bird on top of our vending machine. It hasn't moved since I got here.
lines.zh: : 这话你去跟我们自动售货机上那只怪鸟说吧。从我来这儿起它就没动过。

lines.en: : I could have sworn it was actually dead but I tried poking it the other day and I’m pretty sure it threatened to kill me.
lines.zh: : 我本来敢打包票它已经死了，可前两天我戳了它一下，我敢肯定它威胁说要杀了我。

lines.en: : It didn’t...pull a knife out on you, did it?
lines.zh: : 它该不会……掏出刀来对着你吧？

lines.en: scene iohall3
: Uhh...no. It’s still just a bird after all. It wouldn’t be able to do something like that.
lines.zh: : 呃……没有。说到底它终究只是只鸟，做不出那种事的。

lines.en: : Oh, Io...You sweet, summer child.
lines.zh: : 噢，Io……你这个天真的小傻瓜。

lines.en: : What?...What did I do?
lines.zh: : 什么？……我说错什么了？

lines.en: : You will learn the true nature of that animal in time. For now, it may be best if you remain oblivious.
lines.zh: : 时候到了，你自然会知道那只动物的真面目。眼下，你还是蒙在鼓里比较好。

lines.en: scene iohall4
: Oh...Uhh, okay.
lines.zh: : 哦……呃，好吧。

lines.en: : I still don’t really get it, but you got this really serious look as soon as I brought the bird up, so I’ll listen to you.
lines.zh: : 我还是不太明白，不过我一提起那只鸟你就一脸严肃，那我就听你的吧。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : So anyway, how are things going over here? Hate being around the other girls as much as you expected to?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你在这儿过得怎么样？跟其他女生待在一起，有你预想的那么讨厌吗？

lines.en: scene iohall5
: If you mean the dorms in general and not[school], not really.
lines.zh: : 如果你指的是宿舍整体、而不是[school]的话，倒也没有。

lines.en: : I don’t have to talk to anybody over here.
lines.zh: : 在这儿我谁都不用搭理。

lines.en: : Even when I’m just sitting in the hall, no one other than Uta really makes an effort to talk to me. So that’s cool.
lines.zh: : 就算我就坐在走廊里，除了 Uta 也没谁真的主动来跟我说话。所以挺好的。

lines.en: : No, that’s just depressing. I figured they’d at least try.
lines.zh: : 不，那才叫惨呢。我本以为她们至少会试试。

lines.en: : Ehh. Who knows? Maybe they have and I just haven’t noticed?
lines.zh: : 呃。谁知道呢？也许她们试过了，只是我没注意到？

lines.en: : Either way, not really something I want to spend too much time thinking about.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，这事儿我真不太想花太多时间琢磨。

lines.en: : The dorm itself is really cool.
lines.zh: : 宿舍本身真的很棒。

lines.en: : Even though Uta takes up like 75%% of the room, it’s still cool having a place I can sort of turn into my own little thing.
lines.zh: : 虽然 Uta 一个人就占了房间大概 75% 的地方，但能有个地方让我改造成自己的小天地，还是挺棒的。

lines.en: : Don’t you have a room at the bathhouse?
lines.zh: : 你在澡堂不是有房间吗？

lines.en: : I do, but it’s really just my aunt’s guest room that I wound up moving into and I feel kinda bad about sprucing it up. You know?
lines.zh: : 有是有，但那其实只是我姑姑的客房，我最后就搬进去住了；把它大肆装饰一番，我有点过意不去。你懂吧？

lines.en: : The dorm has a surprisingly small list of rules we need to adhere to, so once I found out I could do whatever I wanted, it made me a lot more comfortable.
lines.zh: : 宿舍要遵守的规矩少得出奇，所以一发现我想干嘛就干嘛，我自在多了。

lines.en: : Only downside is that the showers here don’t get nearly hot enough so I still have to use the ones at work.
lines.zh: : 唯一的缺点是这儿的淋浴水温完全不够热，所以我还得用上班那边的。

lines.en: : I have yet to use the showers here so I can not contribute to this conversation.
lines.zh: : 我还没用过这儿的淋浴，所以这个话题我插不上嘴。

lines.en: : Just get the blonde girl to bring you in there when she takes a shower one day.
lines.zh: : 改天让那个金发姑娘洗澡时把你带进去不就行了。

lines.en: : You guys already bathe together so I’m sure she won’t mind.
lines.zh: : 你们本来就一起泡澡，我肯定她不会介意的。

lines.en: : I feel like there is a high likelihood of that actually happening one day, so I’ll let you know when it does.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这事儿哪天真发生的概率还挺高的，到时候我会告诉你的。

lines.en: scene iohall6
: Uhh...you don’t need to let me know whenever you get naked with some girl. I don’t have to keep tabs on that like Uta does.
lines.zh: : 呃……你跟哪个姑娘赤诚相见不用跟我报备。我可不像 Uta 那样得盯着你。

lines.en: : Finally, someone who understands.
lines.zh: : 总算有个懂我的人了。

lines.en: scene iohall7
: Hey, Sensei, do you know why this[school] has dorms in the first place?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei，你知道这所[school]到底为什么会有宿舍吗？

lines.en: : It’s a public [high_school] so like, isn’t having dorms kind of...weird for somewhere like that?
lines.zh: : 这是公立 [high_school]，所以有宿舍什么的……对这种地方来说是不是有点奇怪？

lines.en: : Not to mention that your class has like, an entire building to itself.
lines.zh: : 更别说你们班还独占了一整栋楼。

lines.en: : Where even is the other dorm?
lines.zh: : 另一栋宿舍到底在哪儿啊？

lines.en: : You’re asking me a bunch of questions I do not have the answer to right now.
lines.zh: : 你这一连串问题，我现在答不上来。

lines.en: : You didn’t learn all this stuff when you became a teacher?
lines.zh: : 你当老师的时候没学过这些吗？

lines.en: : Maybe it’s some sort of conspiracy or something?
lines.zh: : 说不定是什么阴谋之类的？

lines.en: scene iohall8
: Oh man! Great idea!
lines.zh: : 哦天哪！好主意！

lines.en: : Sensei, let’s start a revolution!
lines.zh: : Sensei，我们搞一场革命吧！

lines.en: : ...What?
: What are we revolting against?
lines.zh: : 我们要反抗什么？

lines.en: : Kumon-mi High. We can secede and declare this dorm a republic. Then we won’t have to go to school {i}at all{/i} and can just hang out here every day.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 高中啊。我们可以脱离出去，宣布这栋宿舍独立成共和国。那样我们就{i}完全{/i}不用上学了，每天在这儿混就行。

lines.en: : Yes, I’m sure everyone will love the idea of never going to college and spending the rest of their lives here.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我敢肯定大家都会喜欢「永远不上大学、在这儿过完一辈子」这个主意。

lines.en: Not like anyone is ever going to make it to college anyway.
lines.zh: 反正也没谁真能上得了大学。

lines.en: They’re all caught in an infinite first year of [high_school].
lines.zh: 她们全都困在[high_school]无限循环的一年级里。

lines.en: You know, maybe this does call for a revolution after all?
lines.zh: 话说回来，也许还真需要一场革命？

lines.en: The dorm functioning as an independent entity sounds quite enticing.
lines.zh: 让宿舍作为一个独立实体运作，听起来还挺诱人的。

lines.en: : Who even needs college?
lines.zh: : 谁需要上大学啊？

lines.en: : What’s the point of going into debt just so you can try out for a slightly better job in order to pay off all of it?
lines.zh: : 背上一身债，就为了去争取一份稍微好点的工作来还债，这有什么意义？

lines.en: : That train of thought is too advanced for a girl your age. You need to slow down.
lines.zh: : 你这思路对一个你这个年纪的女孩来说太超前了。你得慢下来。

lines.en: scene iohall9
: More people should just learn tradeskills.
lines.zh: : 应该有更多人去学门手艺。

lines.en: : Sure, a lot of them are less {i}glamorous{/i}, but they’re literally {i}always{/i} needed and there are tons of programs much cheaper than colleges.
lines.zh: : 当然，很多手艺活儿没那么{i}光鲜{/i}，但它们是实打实{i}永远{/i}被需要的，而且有很多比大学便宜得多的培训项目。

lines.en: : Is that what you’re planning on doing?
lines.zh: : 你打算走这条路吗？

lines.en: : Idunno. I should focus on getting out of [high_school] first.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我得先想办法从[high_school]毕业再说。

lines.en: : Good call. Leave all that future-planning stuff to year three- a year you will definitely make it to.
lines.zh: : 明智。那些规划未来的事就留到三年级吧——你肯定会升到三年级的。

lines.en: : Saying it like that makes it sound like I’m going to drop out.
lines.zh: : 你这话说的，搞得我好像会辍学似的。

lines.en: scene iohall7
: I get that I haven’t shown a lot of interest in class yet, but I have no intention of leaving. Especially with you as my teacher.
lines.zh: : 我知道我到现在对上课都没什么兴趣，但我没打算走。尤其是有你当我的老师。

lines.en: : I had a feeling my methods would reach you.
lines.zh: : 我就觉得我的方法能影响到你。

lines.en: scene iohall9
: Well your feeling was spot-on.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你的直觉准得要命。

lines.en: : It’s cool waking up and not dreading whatever is going to happen for the rest of the day immediately.
lines.zh: : 醒来之后不用立刻就对接下来一整天要发生的事感到恐惧，这种感觉真好。

lines.en: : It just sucks that I only have several months of that until it all goes away and I have to find my place in yet {i}another{/i} group of students.
lines.zh: : 只可惜这样的日子只剩几个月了，然后一切就会消失，我又得在{i}另一{/i}群学生里找自己的位置。

lines.en: : Just get held back and stay in my class.
lines.zh: : 那就留级留在我班上呗。

lines.en: Or do nothing at all and achieve the exact same result.
lines.zh: 或者什么都不做，效果一模一样。

lines.en: scene iohall10
: Heheh~ Gonna miss me when I’m gone?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 我走了你会想我吗？

lines.en: : Maybe I {i}will{/i} get held back and then run for class-rep next year so I can spend even more time with you.
lines.zh: : 也许我真的{i}会{/i}留级，然后明年竞选班长，这样就能跟你待更久了。

lines.en: : That sounds great as long as you can figure out how to communicate with others as well.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错——只要你也能学会怎么跟别人沟通。

lines.en: : For the last time, I’m actually pretty good at that. I can do it if I want to.
lines.zh: : 我都说最后一遍了，我其实挺擅长这个的。只要我想，我就做得到。

lines.en: : Right. You just don’t {i}want{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 对。你只是不{i}想{/i}而已。

lines.en: scene iohall11
: Precisely. So stop trying to get me to. Got it?
lines.zh: : 正是。所以别再想逼我了。明白了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I won’t make you do anything you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我不会逼你做任何你不想做的事。

lines.en: : Good. Only someone horrible would force someone into doing something they’re not comfortable with.
lines.zh: : 很好。只有很糟糕的人才会强迫别人去做他们不舒服的事。

lines.en: scene black
Io and I talk for a little while longer before she decides she wants to go back into her room and head to sleep early.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 又聊了一会儿，之后她说想回房间早点睡。

lines.en: Not having anything else to do and feeling a bit guilty about knocking on someone else’s door at this hour of the night, I decide to head home and go to sleep as well.
lines.zh: 反正也没别的事可做，再加上深更半夜去敲别人的门让我有点过意不去，我决定也回家睡觉。

lines.en: else:
I have to go to work tomorrow, so crashing early will be advantageous in the long run.
lines.zh: 明天还得上班，所以早睡从长远来看是有利的。

lines.en: I make my way down the steps of the dorm and into the cold once more, ready for the harsh winds of yet another winter night.
lines.zh: 我走下宿舍的台阶，再一次踏入寒气之中，准备好迎接又一个冬夜的凛冽寒风。

lines.en: ...Or at least that’s what I think until the wind actually hits my skin.
lines.zh: ……至少在寒风真正刮到皮肤上之前，我是这么想的。

lines.en: From that point on, it’s absolute Hell the whole way back.
lines.zh: 从那一刻起，回去的一路简直就是地狱。

lines.en: I wasn't ready at all.
lines.zh: 我压根儿就没准备好。

{i}Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!{/i}
